description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.StringFilter class, a custom filter component for Ext JS grid filtering, based on a configurable text input field.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.StringFilter
classes.description: A filter class for string-based filtering in Ext JS grids, extending Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter, providing a text input for user-defined filtering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, applies configuration, creates a TextField input, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the filter input.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the filter input value and triggers an update event.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter can be activated based on input value length.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter state for server transmission.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter criteria.

methods.name: onInputKeyUp
methods.description: Handles keyup events on the input field, triggers update or hides menu on Return key.
